title: Step 7 - Visualizing UCB Algorithm Results: Histogram Analysis in Python

cues.en: -: Hello my friends, and welcome back to the final step of this implementation, of the upper confidence bound algorithm.
cues.zh: 講師：朋友們，大家好，歡迎回到信賴上界演算法實作的最後一步。

cues.en: We actually already implemented the algorithm itself, in this cell implementing UCB, and now we can just, you know, sit comfortably in our chair, and visualize the results.
cues.zh: 這個 UCB 儲存格已經實作演算法本身，現在可以舒服坐好，看看結果。

cues.en: Because indeed, implementing this final set, will be super easy.
cues.zh: 因為最後這一步非常簡單。

cues.en: We just have to plot a histogram, and make a nice title to the chart and also some labels for the X-axis, and the Y-axis.
cues.zh: 只要畫長條分布圖，加上好看的標題，以及 X、Y 軸標籤。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's create a new coattail here.
cues.zh: 這裡建立新程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: I'm gonna scroll down a bit.
cues.zh: 往下捲一點。

cues.en: All right. And there we go.
cues.zh: 好，來吧。

cues.en: Let's plot that histogram.
cues.zh: 畫這個分布圖。

cues.en: So just to make sure we all understand, this histogram will plot for each of the ads.
cues.zh: 先確保大家了解，這張圖會對每個廣告，

cues.en: Well the number of times it was selected.
cues.zh: 顯示它被選中的次數。

cues.en: So on the X-axis we will have the different ads, you know, from not one to 10, but you know, zero to nine, because we work with indexes and they start from zero.
cues.zh: X 軸是各廣告，不是 1 到 10，而是 0 到 9，因為用的是從 0 開始的索引。

cues.en: And on the Y-axis, we'll have the number of times each of these ads was selected.
cues.zh: Y 軸是每個廣告被選幾次。

cues.en: All right, so, the good news now is that, you know, we already have the tool we need to plot such a histogram, which is (inaudible).
cues.zh: 好消息是，已經有需要的工具，也就是 Matplotlib。

cues.en: And for this we gave the shortcut name PLT.
cues.zh: 給它的簡稱是 plt。

cues.en: So that's what we're gonna start with.
cues.zh: 所以先從這裡開始。

cues.en: PLT.
cues.zh: plt。

cues.en: Calling (inaudible).
cues.zh: 呼叫 matplotlib.pyplot。

cues.en: And from which we're gonna call a specific function from this Pi plot module, which is the hist function.
cues.zh: 從 pyplot 模組呼叫特定函式 hist。

cues.en: And as you might guess, well this his function can plot any histogram, all right?
cues.zh: 你可能猜到，hist 能畫各種直方圖或長條分布圖，好嗎？

cues.en: So let's add some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 加上括號。

cues.en: And now according to you, what do we have to plot in this hist function?
cues.zh: 你覺得 hist 裡該畫什麼？

cues.en: Well that's actually easy, you know, if we scroll down here you can see the parameters.
cues.zh: 其實很簡單，往下看參數。

cues.en: The only parameters that we'll need is this one, X.
cues.zh: 只需要這個參數 x。

cues.en: And this is supposed to be, you know, either an array or a sequence of arrays.
cues.zh: 它應該是陣列或陣列序列。

cues.en: Basically it's going to be a list of values, which will be the values on the Y axis of the histogram, right?
cues.zh: 基本上是值的串列，用來產生長條分布圖 Y 軸的數值，對吧？

cues.en: And therefore, what we simply need to input here in our histogram is, you know, this variable at selected, which we created,
cues.zh: 因此，只要輸入建立好的 ads_selected 變數，

cues.en: which contains indeed the sequence of ads that were selected over the round.
cues.zh: 它包含各回合選取的廣告序列。

cues.en: So keep in mind, ad selected is a list of 10,000 elements where each element is the ad that was selected at a particular round, you know?
cues.zh: 記得 ads_selected 是一萬個元素的串列，每個元素是在特定回合選中的廣告。

cues.en: The end element of this ad selected list is the ad that was selected at round N, you know, shown to the user N, all right?
cues.zh: 第 n 個元素，就是回合 n 選出的廣告，展示給使用者 n，好嗎？

cues.en: And this is exactly what is supposed to be input of this hist function.
cues.zh: 正是 hist 函式需要的輸入。

cues.en: So let's just paste that inside.
cues.zh: 直接貼進去。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Basically, here the job is done.
cues.zh: 基本上工作完成了。

cues.en: This will plot the histogram.
cues.zh: 這就會畫出分布圖。

cues.en: However, of course we wanna make it nice and to make it nice, well, you know, we'll just add a title to this plot and we will choose, you know,
cues.zh: 當然，希望好看一點，所以加標題，選

cues.en: in quotes, this title to be histogram of add selections.
cues.zh: 引號裡的「廣告選取次數分布」。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Then we're gonna add a nice label to the X axis.
cues.zh: 再為 X 軸加好看的標籤。

cues.en: And the function for this remember is X label.
cues.zh: 記得函式是 xlabel。

cues.en: Same as the plot function actually.
cues.zh: 其實和 plot 時一樣。

cues.en: So X label, and then parenthesis, well will give in quote, a nice label to the X axis.
cues.zh: xlabel 加括號，再在引號裡放 X 軸標籤。

cues.en: And since the X axis corresponds to the different ads, you know, from zero to nine because of the button indexes, well we'll set this X label as ads.
cues.zh: X 軸對應不同廣告，因 Python 索引而從 0 到 9，所以標籤設為「廣告」。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then same for the Y label.
cues.zh: Y 軸標籤也一樣。

cues.en: And in parenthesis we will enter in quotes, well this time- well let's make it very clear, you know, let's just input number of times each ad was selected.
cues.zh: 括號加引號，這次寫清楚一點，直接填「每個廣告被選取的次數」。

cues.en: All right, so that it is a hundred percent clear.
cues.zh: 這樣就百分之百清楚。

cues.en: And finally, remember we have to end with plt.show to display the graph in the output of the notebook.
cues.zh: 最後記得用 plt.show，在筆記本輸出顯示圖表。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So we're done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Do you understand what is expected here? Right?
cues.zh: 了解這裡預期看到什麼嗎？

cues.en: In the histogram it is expected, you know, if the UCB algorithm was powerful, it is expected that one of the ads was selected the most.
cues.zh: 如果 UCB 有效，預期圖中某個廣告會被選最多次。

cues.en: You know, was selected way more than the others.
cues.zh: 遠多於其他廣告。

cues.en: Because the goal of the UCB algorithm is to quickly, you know is to fast as possible identify the ad that has the highest CTR.
cues.zh: 因為 UCB 的目標是盡快找出點閱率最高的廣告。

cues.en: And once it is identified, well only this ad will be selected.
cues.zh: 一旦找出，就只選這個廣告。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So we should see one ad that was selected way more than the others.
cues.zh: 所以應該看到一個廣告被選遠多於其他。

cues.en: In other words, we should see one bar in the histogram that is way higher than the others.
cues.zh: 換句話說，有一根長條遠高於其他。

cues.en: Are you ready?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Let's play this sale.
cues.zh: 執行儲存格。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 出來了。

cues.en: We got what we want.
cues.zh: 得到想要的結果。

cues.en: Indeed, this ad of index four here, meaning the ad number five, was clearly the ad selected the most, therefore was clearly the ad with the highest click through rate.
cues.zh: 索引 4，也就是第五個廣告，明顯被選最多，因此是點閱率最高的廣告。

cues.en: And in terms of our business case study, it corresponds indeed to the ad that is the most attractive, meaning the ad that has the most beautiful image of that car that will sell the most
cues.zh: 就商業案例而言，它是最有吸引力的廣告，也就是這台車最漂亮、最能促成銷售的圖片，

cues.en: to the users of future customers.
cues.zh: 對象是使用者或未來顧客。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So good job.
cues.zh: 做得好。

cues.en: The UCB algorithm did a very good job here.
cues.zh: UCB 在這裡表現很好。

cues.en: However, remember that, you know, the goal is in fact to, you know, identify this ad as fast as possible, you know, in a minimum number of rounds.
cues.zh: 但記得，目標其實是盡快，用最少回合辨識出它。

cues.en: And therefore what we should experiment right now, you know, it's not quite over.
cues.zh: 所以現在應該再實驗，還沒完全結束。

cues.en: We should experiment to see in actually how many rounds the UCB algorithm was able to identify this ad with the higher CTR.
cues.zh: 看看 UCB 究竟幾回合能辨識出最高 CTR 的廣告。

cues.en: And the way to check this, is by, you know, changing that value of N here.
cues.zh: 檢查方式是改這裡 N 的值。

cues.en: Because this algorithm was run with 10,000 rounds.
cues.zh: 這次演算法用了 10,000 回合。

cues.en: But what if we put instead, you know, 5,000 rounds, you know, we would like to see if the UCB is still able to identify that ad of index four,
cues.zh: 如果改成 5,000，想知道 UCB 是否仍能在 5,000 回合辨識出索引 4、

cues.en: you know, with the high CTR in 5,000 rounds.
cues.zh: CTR 最高的廣告。

cues.en: So that's exactly what we're gonna check now by, you know, rerun everything.
cues.zh: 現在重新執行全部來檢查。

cues.en: And the way to do this is, by clicking run time here and then restart and run all.
cues.zh: 點 Runtime，再 Restart and run all。

cues.en: And we're gonna see if with 5,000 rounds, while that UCB algorithm is also able to quickly figure out the best ad.
cues.zh: 看看 5,000 回合時，UCB 能不能也很快找出最佳廣告。

cues.en: And yes, very good, even with 5,000 rounds, you know, with 5,000 users, the UCB was able to identify the ad with the highest CTR.
cues.zh: 可以，很好，即使只有 5,000 回合、5,000 位使用者，也找出最高 CTR 的廣告。

cues.en: And now let's make it even more challenging to the UCB.
cues.zh: 再增加挑戰。

cues.en: Let's replace 5,000 here by 1000 and let's click run time again and restart, and run all and let's see if with only 1000 rounds
cues.zh: 把 5,000 換成 1,000，再點 Runtime、Restart and run all，看看只有一千回合時，

cues.en: while the UCB is able to...
cues.zh: UCB 能不能……

cues.en: Wow, okay, so still it was still able to do it, you know, identifying the ad with the highest CTR, which is still of course ad of index four, but quite just, you know.
cues.zh: 哇，仍然做到了，找出最高 CTR 的廣告，當然還是索引 4，但有點勉強。

cues.en: So now I of course want to try with 500 rounds, right?
cues.zh: 現在當然想試五百回合。

cues.en: We're gonna replace that 1000 here by 500 then rerun everything by clicking, restart and run all.
cues.zh: 把一千換成五百，點 Restart and run all，重新執行全部。

cues.en: And now let's see, but I'm not sure, right?
cues.zh: 來看看，不太確定。

cues.en: Let's see if it is still able to identify that ad with the highest CTR.
cues.zh: 是否還能辨識出最高 CTR 的廣告。

cues.en: And that's what I'm talking about.
cues.zh: 這就是我說的。

cues.en: You know, 500 rounds is not enough for the UCB algorithm to identify that best ad, you know, that ad with the highest CTR because indeed the ad with the highest CTR
cues.zh: 五百回合不足以讓 UCB 辨識出最佳、最高 CTR 的廣告，因為最高 CTR

cues.en: is clearly ad number four but in 500 rounds the UCB identified the best ad as ad of index seven.
cues.zh: 顯然是索引 4，但五百回合裡，UCB 認為最佳的是索引 7。

cues.en: So 500 is not enough.
cues.zh: 所以五百不夠。

cues.en: And so now it'll be very interesting to see with the Thompson sampling algorithm if you know it can beat the UCB algorithm in the sense that it can find this ad of index four
cues.zh: 接著很值得看 Thompson 抽樣能不能勝過 UCB，也就是在五百回合中，找出索引 4、

cues.en: with the highest CTR in 500 rounds because the UCB can clearly find it in 1000 rounds, that's for sure, but not in 500 rounds.
cues.zh: 最高 CTR 的廣告。UCB 肯定能在一千回合找到，但五百不行。

cues.en: So we're gonna see with Thompson sampling algorithm if this one is able to find that best ad, you know, because we're gonna work on the same data set of course, if it is going to identify
cues.zh: 會看 Thompson 抽樣能不能找到，因為當然用同一份資料集，是否能在五百回合辨識

cues.en: that best ad of index for in 500 rounds.
cues.zh: 出最佳的索引 4 廣告。

cues.en: And if yes, we will even try lower numbers of rounds.
cues.zh: 如果可以，甚至會試更少回合。

cues.en: So I can't wait to now implement Thompson sampling with you.
cues.zh: 迫不及待和你一起實作 Thompson 抽樣。

cues.en: We will work on the exact same data set.
cues.zh: 會用完全相同的資料集。

cues.en: So we will just compare.
cues.zh: 所以只要比較。

cues.en: So let's do this in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一個單元來做。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
